Reference 2 is original Kora full body for proportions and tactile soft 3D fur. Reference 3 is the EDIT TARGET for clothing, framing and pose ONLY, not a face-design reference. Rebuild target's face to remain instantly recognizable as reference 1 and 2; do not invent another koala character. Preserve the exact nose length/width, small eye size, eye spacing, muzzle proportions and fur colors of the originals. Do not feminize or masculinize; no eyelashes, makeup, human eyebrows, human-shaped eyes, large white sclera, teeth, human lips or sharper cheek/jaw shapes. WITTY / DRY HUMOR acting: half-lower the soft furry upper eyelids over the SAME small black bead eyes for an obvious deadpan 'really?' look. Keep both eyes similar size and same spacing. One side of the original tiny closed mouth lifts slightly, a dry amused smile, NOT a human sneer. Head tilted slightly, original raised-paw shrug in charcoal sportswear. Personality should be legible, facial anatomy remains original Kora.
